changes: Added a convergence + takeover circuit breaker: core/convergence-breaker.ts derives four cheap read-only per-story signals (advance-count, review pass-rate, takeover frequency, repeated-identical-gate-failure) and hard-stops story_advance on a pathological signature; one-shot auto-recovery re-baselines ALL signals, then a re-trip freezes with a human-only story_resume ack refused under autopilot/non-interactive. Takeover + gate-failure counters bump at existing write sites; state is gitignored.
usage: Runs automatically at the story_advance choke point. Tune via LATTICE_CONVERGENCE_MAX_ADVANCE (20) / MAX_TAKEOVER (5) / MIN_PASS_RATE (0.35) / MIN_SAMPLE (10) / MAX_GATE_REPEAT (2). A frozen story is cleared by an interactive human: lattice story_resume --storyId=<id> --ack --reason=<why>.
expectedOutcome: The full original outcome is delivered: when a runaway story crosses a pathological threshold (cumulative advances, review pass-rate, or takeover count) the framework freezes the story; the operator sees a rejection at story_advance naming the tripped counters and the resume command, and the story cannot advance until a human explicitly acks/resumes. A healthy story (6-10 advances, ~1 takeover) is never frozen, and the first trip auto-recovers once so a legitimately long story is not blocked; only a re-trip freezes. The ack refuses under autopilot/non-interactive mode.
actualTranscript: npm run test:convergence-breaker prints PASS across 15 sections; real-CLI: a frozen story_advance was rejected before the checklist gate with the tripped-counter freeze message; story_resume was refused in a non-interactive session; git check-ignore confirms the three runtime files are ignored.
outcomeDiff: expected vs actual: identical and fully equivalent to the original intent. The storm signature trips all four signals and freezes on re-trip; the healthy control never trips; the first trip auto-recovers once; the ack refuses non-interactively; runtime state stays gitignored. The delivery also exceeds the original snapshot by adding a fourth read-only signal (repeated-identical-gate-failure), takeover-command blocking while frozen, and path-traversal guards. No part of the intended outcome was reduced.
limitations: Full outcome delivered with no reduction. The human-ack presence check (stdin.isTTY plus autopilot/CI markers, an explicit --ack, and a human --reason) fully covers the intended threat: an unattended autopilot session self-acking a freeze. A cryptographic out-of-band operator attestation is a possible future enhancement beyond this story's intent. A follow-up task (task_a9610374) tracks one minor internal cleanup (an unused parameter in resumeBreakerState) that has no effect on behavior.
pitfalls: Every material change re-stales verificationEvidence pins and reviewer passes — run recover_evidence (not just refresh_stale) to rebind after any code edit. The gate-failure reset is scoped to successful story_advance ONLY (not any mutation) so a runaway cannot defeat gate-repeat via a no-op success. Never derive a story path from a non-canonical storyId (isCanonicalStoryId guards all three counter/gate sites).
